description: This file defines the 'Fees' class for handling fee-related operations in an ERPNext educational module, including calculations, validation, and document management.

classes.name: Fees
classes.description: A class representing the fee document, handling validation, calculations, and related operations.

methods.name: set_indicator
methods.description: Sets the indicator color and title based on outstanding amount.

methods.name: set_missing_accounts_and_fields
methods.description: Assigns default accounts and fields if missing.

methods.name: get_student_emails
methods.description: Retrieves email addresses of the student and guardians.

methods.name: calculate_total
methods.description: Calculates total fee amount and converts to words.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions upon submission, including creating payment requests.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles actions upon cancellation, including reversing GL entries.

methods.name: make_gl_entries
methods.description: Creates general ledger entries for the fee.
